page_note: ACEA 报告第16页「COMMERCIAL VEHICLES / REGISTRATIONS / Global」正文加一幅堆积柱状图 Figure 4，按七个地区拆分 Vans/Trucks/Buses 新车销量。

heading.title: Global new commercial vehicles and bus sales¹⁰

components.evidence: each region bar carries Vans, Trucks and Buses segments stacked to the bar total
'Vans  Trucks  Buses' swatch row sits between the caption and the plot area
'SOURCE: S&P GLOBAL MOBILITY' printed in small type under the plot
'North America', 'Greater China', 'Middle East/Africa' set vertically, turned 90 degrees
caption reads 'Global new commercial vehicles and bus sales¹⁰' with footnote 10 at page foot
body text 'Greater China⁹' with '⁹ Includes Mainland China, and Taiwan' at page foot
faint horizontal rules at each million tick, no vertical rules in the panel
Buses segments (e.g. 120,997) are hairline slivers at the bar tops, unlabelled
axis slots are region codes/groupings 'Japan/Korea', 'Middle East/Africa'

new_components.name: full_number_thousands_separator_ticks
new_components.evidence: value axis prints '5,000,000 ... 1,000,000, 0' in full digits rather than a scaled unit
new_components.why_it_matters: 刻度以完整千分位数字书写，读数需与文中「4 million units」这类缩写单位换算，表格里也要保留 4,000,000 这种写法才能匹配。

new_components.name: unit_absent_on_count_axis
new_components.evidence: no '%', 'units' or scale phrase anywhere on figure; only 'sales' in the caption
new_components.why_it_matters: 图上没有任何单位短语，读者只能从正文「units」推断计数单位，解析出的表格若无标题就无法确定量纲。

new_components.name: segment_value_only_in_body_text
new_components.evidence: '120,997 units', '96,949 units', '60,625', '55,322' appear only in the prose above the figure
new_components.why_it_matters: 最细的 Buses 分段数值只存在于正文，表格化时必须把正文数字与图上分段对应，否则该值无处可查。

spot_checks.mark: the North America Vans segment (bar bottom segment, top edge at the 4,000,000 gridline)
the Greater China Vans segment, topping just under the 3,000,000 gridline
the Greater China Trucks segment (~2.97M to ~4.03M, i.e. about 1,000,000 tall)
the Europe Vans segment, top edge just under halfway between 2,000,000 and 3,000,000
the South Asia Vans segment, top edge halfway between 1,000,000 and 2,000,000
the South America Vans segment, top edge slightly above the 1,000,000 gridline
the North America Vans segment again, unformatted spelling of the same quantity
the Greater China Trucks segment again, unformatted spelling
the Greater China Buses segment; the number itself appears only in the prose ('120,997 units')
the South Asia Buses segment; number given only in the prose ('96,949 units')

difficulty_notes: 刻度间距为 1,000,000，全图高度仅约 300 px，1 px 约等于 17,000 辆；而被考核的 Buses 值 120,997 与 96,949 只占约 7 px 与 6 px，5% 容差分别是 ±6,050 与 ±4,847，即不到半个像素，纯靠像素读数根本不可能达到。Vans 段（4,000,000、2,500,000、1,500,000）虽然刚好落在或贴近网格线，尚可读到 5% 内，但整幅图无任何数值标签，Trucks 段还需用上下沿相减，误差叠加。相比之下寻址只需「地区 + 系列」两个键，标题也是加粗彩色的独立行，反而不是瓶颈。
